title: Divide, sort, merge
body: What is merge sort's typical time complexity?
takeaway: Each level processes n items across log n levels.

title: Remember overlapping answers
body: Dynamic programming stores answers to repeated subproblems instead of solving them again.
takeaway: Look for overlapping subproblems and an optimal substructure.

title: Choose locally, prove globally
body: What does a greedy algorithm do at each step?
takeaway: Greedy choices need a proof that local decisions lead to a global optimum.

title: Say what, not every how
body: Declarative code describes the desired transformation instead of manual control flow.
takeaway: Prefer expressive pipelines when they stay readable.

title: Cache a pure result
body: Memoization is safest when a function is what?
takeaway: Same input, same output makes cached results valid.

title: Model absence explicitly
body: Option or nullable types force callers to acknowledge that a value may be missing.
takeaway: Make impossible assumptions visible in the type system.

title: Safe to repeat
body: An idempotent operation can be repeated with what effect?

title: Do not fetch the universe
body: Pagination bounds response size and lets interfaces progressively load large collections.
takeaway: Prefer stable cursor pagination when data changes frequently.

title: Wait for typing to pause
body: Debouncing replaces many rapid search calls with one call after a quiet period.
takeaway: Debounce user bursts; throttle sustained streams.

title: Why did old clients break?
body: The server renamed a required JSON field without coordinating clients. What was missing?
takeaway: Evolve contracts additively or version breaking changes.
